ai_content.dream_summary: I dreamt of a picture book someone kept turning for me. Every time a page flipped, the whole scene changed under my paws, grass to water to warm stone, before I could even sniff at it properly. My ears kept twitching at each new smell, chasing them but never quite landing, until the pages finally slowed and I curled up on whatever page was last.
